query:
UPDATE follows SET
            show_reblogs = COALESCE($3, show_reblogs),
            with_replies = COALESCE($4, with_replies),
            notify = COALESCE($5, notify),
            languages = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7::text[] ELSE languages END
        WHERE account_id = $1 AND target_account_id = $2
